entities.title: Unsigned scripts have no network
entities.summary: A script gets network access only when its manifest asks for it and its signer is an authority this machine trusts with network (D4).
entities.impact: An unsigned or untrusted script's HTTP requests fail with network_denied, in tests (except the replay file) and in use.
entities.workaround: Sign it with `zazz sign` using an authority whose grants include the hosts, and trust that authority on the machine (`zazz trust add`, as root).

entities.title: No WASM worker without an OS sandbox
entities.summary: On Linux without Landlock, or on macOS without /usr/bin/sandbox-exec, builds, tests and WASM calls are refused.
entities.impact: `zazz test`, `zazz add` and `zazz call` fail with sandbox_unavailable; `zazz doctor` reports it.

entities.title: Native scripts' network is all or nothing
entities.summary: A script running natively gets network on or off; its manifest's and authority's host lists are checked only by zazz-worker for WASM, and the macOS profile allows any outbound connection when network is on.
entities.impact: A natively trusted script with any network grant can reach any host the OS lets it.

entities.title: Rust scripts build with std and the SDK only
entities.summary: zazz compiles a Rust script with rustc directly against the embedded zazz SDK: no Cargo dependencies, build scripts or proc-macros.
entities.impact: A script that needs other crates cannot be shipped as Rust source.
entities.workaround: Build it to wasm32-wasip1 elsewhere and ship the module with kind "wasm" (D1).

entities.title: Captured output is cut at 1 MiB
entities.summary: Without the invoker's streams (over MCP, or when add asks for an OpenAPI document) each of stdout and stderr is captured up to 1 MiB.
entities.impact: Anything a script writes beyond that is dropped from the reply.
entities.workaround: Return results as the script's JSON output, or run it through the invoker, where it writes to the caller's own streams.

entities.title: Prebuilt native binaries are refused
entities.summary: A manifest of kind native-bin is refused for every signer: only the release authority was to ship them (D12), and there is none yet.
entities.impact: `zazz add` and `zazz test` fail with unsupported.
